'''João Pedro da Silva Teixeira''' (born 17 July 1996) is a [[association football|football]] player who plays as a [[midfielder]] for [[GD Vilar de Perdizes|Vilar de Perdizes]]. Born in Portugal, he represents the [[Andorra national football team|Andorra national team]].

==International career==
Teixeira made his debut for the senior [[Andorra national football team|Andorra national team]] on 21 March 2024 in a friendly against [[South Africa national soccer team|South Africa]].<ref>{{cite web|publisher=ESPN|url=https://www.espn.co.uk/football/match/_/gameId/698287/andorra-south-africa|title=Andorra v South Africa game report|date=21 March 2024}}</ref>
